summary.title: 🌈 The Book (scrty.io)
summary.one_liner: A large index of Ryan McGeehan's information security essays and links for growing teams, covering risk management, forecasting, incident response, policy, detection, product security and AWS.
takeaways: The book is organized into chapters covering risk, forecasting, organization, incident response, policy and compliance, detection, product security, vulnerability disclosure and AWS.
It includes reference links such as the NIST Cybersecurity Framework, Verizon Data Breach Report and FTC's Start with Security.
Risk chapters focus on decomposing risk into scenarios, measuring risk and estimating unknowns, including dollar estimates of incidents.
Incident response and startup chapters cover breach 101/102, phishing incidents, tabletop scenarios and writing playbooks.
summary.summary: This is the landing page for a collection of information security essays written by Ryan McGeehan, aimed at new leadership in new security teams. The page is mostly a table of contents grouped into sections such as Foundations, Management, Fundamentals, Building, Breaking and Incidents, with many linked essays and some external references. The page text does not describe a method beyond the essays themselves, and the listing shows no difficulty level. It works as an index to find specific articles by topic.
